whenToUse: Results come in different kinds, such as products, brands, or posts.
Each kind looks different and is hard to mix.
Narrowing the scope of a unified search.
whenNotToUse: Applying conditions within one kind (use search filters).
There are six or more scopes.
There are few results and one list is enough.

alternatives.name: Tabs
alternatives.reason: Switching content groups unrelated to search.

alternatives.name: Segmented Control
alternatives.reason: Only changing how results are shown.

accessibility: Use the tablist, tab, and tabpanel roles with aria-selected and aria-controls.
Moving tabs with ←/→, Home, and End changes the results at once.
Only the selected tab is in the Tab order, so the tab list is passed in one step.
Tab names include the result count, read along with them.
